designs.name: 疏朗半束
designs.front: A restrained slightly off-center parted front crown with broad soft flowing locks swept toward the ears, a few natural thin strands by the temples. Two tapered long shoulder-front locks, left slightly fuller than right; no blunt short side wedges. Composed elegant scholar, light airy separation but NOT excessive volume.
designs.back: Small low half-up knot behind the upper crown, tied with a thin dark brown cord, remaining long straight-flowing back hair with slight natural bends and feathered ends; NO pin, NO crown, NO jewelry. The knot around x516,y162 remains subtle, uppermost y140.

designs.name: 清劲高束
designs.front: Clean forward-facing male front hair, subtle three-seven side part, naturally swept upward and back with fine separated combed strands. Restrained swept fringe at the side of the forehead, both eyes unobscured. Two very slim loose temple strands extending naturally to chest level. Masculine yet delicate ink illustration, no slick wet scalp, no enormous pompadour.
designs.back: A high tied ponytail behind head, modest dark cloth tie, small rounded gathered top around x516,y132 (uppermost y98), long gently curved ponytail flowing behind neck and shoulders to y1000. Filled narrow posterior cap and lower continuous hair; not a front-facing hairline, no face hole. No metal accessories.

designs.name: 松风低束
designs.front: Natural center-parted male front hair, restrained asymmetry and slightly undulating locks gently lifted from crown, narrow wispy temple strands framing ears without baking ears into the hair. Long tapered locks with slight S curves at the lower ends, neat natural texture, NO loops, no hard-cut shoulder wedges, no huge side wings.
designs.back: Low tied long hair gathered at nape around y480 with a dark cord, a softly rounded narrow posterior cap and straight layered lengths flowing behind shoulders to y1020, gentle tapering tips. No upper bun at all, no ornament, no ribbons sticking out. Fully filled hair behind head, no face opening.

pair1_front:
Generate a NEW original male FRONT HAIR layer for a modular Chinese ink portrait game. This is a new design, not recoloring any old male hair. Image1 is female hair, use ONLY its EXACT warm charcoal-black ink hue, fine matte strand rendering and restrained soft highlights; image2 is the immutable male bald head positioning reference, never include it in output. NEW DESIGN: A restrained slightly off-center parted front crown with broad soft flowing locks swept toward the ears, a few natural thin strands by the temples. Two tapered long shoulder-front locks, left slightly fuller than right; no blunt short side wedges. Composed elegant scholar, light airy separation but NOT excessive volume.
Transparent RGBA1024x1536 full canvas. Male head stays fixed: dome top around(516,174), ears y350..440, chin(516,546). Hair must fit those anchors without covering eyes around y379. Front crown modest outer top y155..165, outer bounds approximately x350..680 around y300, center516. DO NOT make huge puffed crown or wide helmet; small natural air above scalp only. Hairline centered around(516,280), temples around(415,330)/(615,330); large fully TRANSPARENT face opening. Front hair includes crown in front of vertex, hairline, temple and shoulder-front locks ONLY. No bun in front layer. Long side locks taper continuously to y1000..1080; no cut-off sections, shoulder-height truncated wedges, stair steps, loops or pale rectangular patches. Keep front width ~320px at head height; posterior will be narrower ~240px. MATCH female material, not silvery/white/grey fog, not black plastic, not wet shine; very fine understated irregular hand-painted filaments. No skin/ears/head/neck/clothes/jewelry/border/text/background/glow/shadow. All surrounding space and face opening genuinely transparent.
pair1_back:
Generate a NEW male POSTERIOR HAIR layer matching paired front hair image1. Image1 defines style/material and fixed placement, image2 is female hair reference ONLY for warm charcoal-black color and fine matte ink strands, image3 is immutable male head position reference (do not output skin). DESIGN: Small low half-up knot behind the upper crown, tied with a thin dark brown cord, remaining long straight-flowing back hair with slight natural bends and feathered ends; NO pin, NO crown, NO jewelry. The knot around x516,y162 remains subtle, uppermost y140.
Transparent1024x1536 full canvas, origin unchanged, center x516. This is the layer BEHIND a front-facing head, not a complete hairstyle painted around a face hole: continuously filled posterior cap and hidden interior. At head height y250..400 the back cap must stay narrower than the front: x395..635 (about240px), no broad frontal crown wings, no forehead hairline, no temples or face-framing locks. Posterior upper cap approx y165 (apart from specified knot/ponytail above). Natural slight rounded volume, no flat tight scalp, no enormous dome. Lower hair follows behind ears/neck, gently spreads to x355..677 around y650, then finely tapered ends by y1000..1050. Front hair will supply wider frontal crown and long shoulder-front strands. Render complete hidden center under face/neck, no holes, no horizontal cut. Match paired front texture and female warm deep charcoal, thin irregular soft highlights, NOT white/silver filaments, not metallic/plastic, no gray background fog. NO head/ears/skin/clothes/text/background/glow. Clean true transparent cutout, no colored fringes.
